newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN BANKS CUT RATE MARGINS TO RECORD LOWS.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN BANKS CUT RATE MARGINS TO RECORD LOWS.

text.p: Hungarian banks reduced their average interest rate margin in corporate business for maximum one year maturities to 4.1 percent in May, the lowest level in five years, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said.
The average loan interest rate dropped 0.3 percentage point to 22 percent in May, while the average deposit rate rose 0.1 percentage pgint to 17.9 percent, the NBH said in a statement.
However, the average rates for longer than one year contracts reversed a declining trend of several months in May as demand shifted towards these maturities, the NBH said.
The average interest rate on longer than one-year deposits rose 1.7 percentage point to 20.2 percent in May, while the average loan interest rate increased by 0.2 percentage point to 23 percent.
